name: Siemens Energy India Ltd.
business_summary: Demerged from Siemens Ltd in April 2025 and listed since; 75% held by Siemens Energy AG. Supplies grid technologies (power and traction transformers, HVDC, switchgear), gas turbines and services, steam turbines and compressors for power and process industries. Financial year ends September. TTM sales Rs 9,436 cr, OPM ~21%, net cash, ROCE 68%. Order backlog Rs 19,331 cr (30 Jun 2026, +16.4% YoY). Rs 2,060 cr transformer expansion capex was approved in Aug 2025 (Angel One). Segment splits are model estimates.

revenue_mix.segment: Gas Services and power generation (turbines, services)

exposures.mechanism: Grid Technologies (transformers, HVDC, switchgear) is roughly half of revenue (model estimate). +1 theme unit = +20% grid order intake -> backlog (Rs 19,331 cr, ~2x LTM sales) extends; +8% revenue at 30% contribution margin -> EBITDA +11% at 21% OPM; persistence 0.6; EV/MCap ~0.97 -> ~+6.

evidence.note: Jun-2026 qtr: revenue Rs 2,486 cr +39.3%, PAT Rs 441 cr +67.8%, backlog Rs 19,331 cr +16.4%

exposures.mechanism: PGCIL/state transmission, railways and public power capex are the main buyers. +10% capex growth -> +4% revenue -> EBITDA +6% -> persistence 0.6 -> ~+3.5; rounded to +4 for the high operating leverage visible in the OPM jump to 21-24%.
+3 pp demand growth lifts generation capex (gas turbines, services) and T&D; +4% revenue over 12 months, EBITDA +6%, persistence 0.5 -> ~+3.

Data-centre power (captive gas turbines, transformers, switchgear) demand; Siemens Energy AG CEO says the boom lasts (EnergyNow 2026-11-04). +1 unit = +15% DC-linked orders (~12% of orders) -> +2% revenue -> EBITDA +3%, persistence 0.7 -> ~+3 incl. sentiment.
HVDC for renewable evacuation, grid-forming equipment, hydrogen/storage interfaces. +1 unit -> +10% HVDC/transformer pipeline -> ~+3.

Global AI-capex sentiment moves the whole listed power-equipment basket: AI-related stocks fell up to 5-6% on 2026-10-13, 10-15 and 10-30 (Moneycontrol). Pack beta to S&P +3.17 (t=1.5). +10% AI capex growth -> sentiment/valuation +2.5.

Copper windings ~10% of costs; price-variation clauses recover ~70% on domestic grid orders. +10% -> costs +1.0%, 30% unrecovered = 0.3% -> EBITDA -1.4% at 21% OPM; persistence 0.25 -> ~-0.35, set to -0.5. Pack -0.68 (t=-0.4) agrees in sign.
CRGO electrical steel and structural steel ~8% of costs; +7% -> costs +0.56%, 30% unrecovered -> EBITDA -0.8%; persistence 0.3 -> ~-0.3.

Imports from Siemens Energy group are ~30% of material costs (model estimate) with FX variation clauses on part of the book. +3% -> costs +0.6-0.9% with ~half recovered -> EBITDA -1.5%; persistence 0.25 -> ~-0.4.
Net cash; effect is valuation duration at P/E 67 and customer capex financing. +25 bp -> ~-1.5%.
Gas services/turbines: higher LNG makes gas power less competitive and delays gas-turbine orders; pack -1.20 per +15% (t=-1.3). Weak, small.
High-beta, richly valued name; +5 VIX points -> ~-1% to -2% relative.

Hitachi Energy, GE Vernova T&D, CG Power, Siemens Ltd peers and new entrants add transformer/switchgear capacity (market discussions 2026-10-11 Livemint). +1 unit = ~100 bp margin pressure -> EBITDA -4.5% at 21% OPM; persistence 0.7; prob-weighted -> ~-3.
